observed_gap: The canonical bridge re-ranked a fixed catalog of repository-context, editing, validation and delivery candidates on every run even after those capabilities were already materialized in main.
That stale catalog could make North Star selection insensitive to the latest main state, contradicting the requirement to re-observe real code and evidence before each cycle.
changes: bridge/dwac_bridge.py now probes the workspace HEAD, materialized capability evidence and structured truth-boundary records before constructing North Star observations and candidates.
Already-materialized capabilities are suppressed from the current candidate set instead of being repeatedly treated as open work.
The bridge exposes workspace_observation with head, closed_capabilities and truth_boundaries for auditable routing provenance.
The observer closes itself after materialization, allowing the next cycle to move on instead of self-selecting indefinitely.
Unresolved persistent PTY remains an internal candidate while GitHub remote delivery is explicitly marked as an external side-effect candidate so DWAC sovereignty rules can gate it.
truth_boundaries: Focused verification uses a synthetic DWAC root implementing the current TaoX North Star and four-mode contracts; it does not claim a full local materialization of the private TaoX repository in the validation container.
The observer uses conservative source/evidence probes, not a claim of full semantic proof that every materialized capability is complete.
No GitHub Actions were triggered or rerun for this verification.
